name: @coursekata/find-duplicate-items
description: GitHub Action to find duplicate items in CourseKata courses.
author: Adam Blake <adam@coursekata.org>

scripts.bundle: npm run format:write && npm run package
scripts.lint: npx eslint . -c ./.github/linters/.eslintrc.yml && (command -v actionlint >/dev/null && actionlint || echo 'actionlint not found, skipping') && (command -v zizmor >/dev/null && zizmor .github/workflows/ || echo 'zizmor not found, skipping')
scripts.package: npx ncc build src/index.ts -o dist --source-map --license licenses.txt && npx ncc build src/cli.ts -o dist/cli-tmp --source-map && mv dist/cli-tmp/index.js dist/cli.js && mv dist/cli-tmp/index.js.map dist/cli.js.map && rm -rf dist/cli-tmp
scripts.all: npm run format:write && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run coverage && npm run package
